snippet.title: SCOPECREEP - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A whispering flame craves souls. With each offering, your resolve strengthens. Fight spirits, collect their essences, and feed a hunger that may never subside in this short eerie incremental game.

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3595710/scopecreep
